heroHeadline: Man Detained Over Threats and Alleged Attack Plan Against PM Tusk and Defence Minister
heroSubtitle: Police detained a man of about 60, a Polish citizen, on 11 Oct after a tip passed via the State Protection Service about a planned attack on Tusk and Kosiniak-Kamysz. No charges, weapons seizure or foreign link had been reported; media accounts of a radical group are unconfirmed. A separate Russian-ordered plot was foiled in August.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Polish government statements, major international outlets, and institutional analyses.
